steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Business aims: the general long-term goals of a business - e.g. 'to become the UK's leading online retailer'. Business objectives: specific, measurable targets that help achieve the aim - e.g. 'increase online sales by 15% in 2024'. | Key Fact: Common objectives: survival (especially for new businesses), profit maximisation (maximise difference between revenue and costs), growth (increase size, revenue, market share), customer satisfaction (retain customers, positive reviews), social/ethical objectives (fair trade, reducing carbon footprint). | Key Fact: SMART objectives: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound.
